properties_with_code.text: Data column sidecar proposer signature must be BLS-verified before acceptance.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall sidecar via P2P: gossip_accept(sidecar) => bls_verify(sidecar.signed_block_header) == true

properties_with_code.text: Data column sidecar proposer_index must match expected proposer for the slot.
KZG proofs must pass batch verification before data column sidecar is accepted via gossip.
Merkle inclusion proof must link KZG commitments to block body_root before acceptance.
Data column sidecar index must be in range [0, NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS).
properties_with_code.assertion: forall sidecar: verify_data_column_sidecar(sidecar) => sidecar.index >= 0 && sidecar.index < NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS

properties_with_code.text: KZG commitments list must not be empty in a valid data column sidecar.
Column, KZG commitments, and KZG proofs arrays must have equal length.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall sidecar: valid(sidecar) => len(column) == len(kzg_commitments) == len(kzg_proofs)

properties_with_code.text: KZG commitments count must not exceed max_blobs_per_block for the epoch.
Beacon block blob_kzg_commitments count must not exceed epoch-dependent max_blobs_per_block.
Gossip deduplication key must be (slot, proposer_index, sidecar.index) — first valid sidecar accepted only.
Anti-equivocation cache must be updated regardless of whether sidecar is published.
ReqResp data_column_sidecars_by_range must not return more than MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS.
ReqResp data_column_sidecars_by_root must reject requests exceeding MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall req: sum(len(r.columns) for r in req) > MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS => reject(req)

properties_with_code.text: Sidecars must only be served from the current fork choice chain, not orphaned blocks.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall sidecar in resp: sidecar.block_root in fork_choice.canonical_chain()

properties_with_code.text: Serve range for data columns must be [max(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH), current_epoch].
Gossip must reject data column sidecars received on wrong subnet.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall sidecar on subnet_id: compute_subnet_for_data_column_sidecar(sidecar.index) != subnet_id => REJECT

properties_with_code.text: Gossip must ignore data column sidecars with slots in the future.
Gossip must ignore data column sidecars with slots at or before finalized checkpoint.
Gossip must reject data column sidecars whose parent block fails validation.
Gossip must reject data column sidecars whose slot is not higher than parent slot.
Gossip must reject sidecars whose finalized checkpoint is not an ancestor of the sidecar block.
All P2P input is untrusted; every gossip and ReqResp message must be fully validated.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall msg via P2P: process(msg) => validated(msg) == true

properties_with_code.text: Blobs from local EL via engine_getBlobsV2 skip KZG verification — compromised EL can inject invalid data.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall blob via engine_getBlobsV2: !verify_kzg(blob) && trust(EL) == semi_trusted

properties_with_code.text: ENR eth2 field epoch is determined by wall-clock time, not sync state.
Anti-equivocation cache dedup key (slot, proposer_index, index) prevents duplicate sidecar forwarding.
After upgrade_to_fulu, all pre-state fields except fork and proposer_lookahead are preserved.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall field in pre except {fork, proposer_lookahead}: post[field] == pre[field]

properties_with_code.text: After upgrade_to_fulu, fork.previous_version equals pre-state fork.current_version.
After upgrade_to_fulu, fork.current_version equals FULU_FORK_VERSION.
After upgrade_to_fulu, proposer_lookahead is freshly initialized via initialize_proposer_lookahead.
BPO forks must not change next_fork_version, only next_fork_epoch in ENR eth2 field.
Deprecated blob_sidecars_by_range must only serve pre-Fulu blobs during transition period.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall sidecar in blob_by_range_resp: sidecar.slot < start_slot(FULU_FORK_EPOCH)

properties_with_code.text: blob_sidecars_by_range is fully deprecated after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS.
properties_with_code.assertion: cur_epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS => blob_by_range returns empty

properties_with_code.text: Peers must not be penalized for requesting blob sidecars from FULU_FORK_EPOCH during transition.
blob_sidecars_by_root is fully deprecated after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS.
properties_with_code.assertion: cur_epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS => blob_by_root returns empty

properties_with_code.text: Distributed blob publishing must only publish on subscribed subnets (custody or sampling).
Imported data columns via distributed publishing must behave as if received via gossip.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall dc via dist_publish: semantics(dc) == semantics(gossip_received(dc))

properties_with_code.text: data_column_sidecars_by_range must return ResourceUnavailable for ranges outside serve range.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall req: req.range outside data_column_serve_range => respond(ResourceUnavailable(3))

properties_with_code.text: Sidecars by root must only serve blocks passing gossip validation and beacon state transition.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall sidecar in by_root_resp: gossip_valid(sidecar.block) && state_transition_valid(sidecar.block)

properties_with_code.text: All REJECT checks in gossip validation must fail before a data column sidecar is forwarded.
Fiat-Shamir challenge must include all verifier-relevant data to prevent selective forgery.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall batch_verify(comms, cells, proofs): hash_input includes domain_sep, comms, cell_indices, evals, proofs

properties_with_code.text: Domain separator in Fiat-Shamir hash must prevent cross-protocol replay attacks.
KZG batch verification pairing check must hold: e(LL, LR) == e(RL, G2).
properties_with_code.assertion: verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_impl returns true iff pairing_check([[LL, LR], [RL, neg(G2)]]) == true

properties_with_code.text: All commitment_indices in batch verification must reference valid deduplicated entries.
Batch verify input lists (commitments, cell_indices, cells, proofs) must have equal length.
Cell indices must be bounded by CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB to prevent out-of-bounds access.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall idx in cell_indices: idx < CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB

properties_with_code.text: Recovery requires at least 50% of cells (CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB / 2) for Reed-Solomon reconstruction.
Cell indices for recovery must be unique and sorted in ascending order.
Recovered polynomial must have degree < FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB after erasure decoding.
Coset FFT division must avoid division by zero by evaluating over shifted domain.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall x in coset_domain: vanishing_poly(x) != 0 when coset != FFT_domain

properties_with_code.text: Vanishing polynomial must evaluate to zero at all missing cell evaluation points.
properties_with_code.assertion: forall i in missing_cell_indices: evaluate(zero_poly, root_of_unity[i]) == 0
